CustomField.complianceGroup: Integrity - Accurate;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Source - Salesforce
CustomField.description: To check if record is eligible to have notification generated that it is about to expire
CustomField.formula: ( UPPER(TEXT(Lead_Originator__c)) = "CCRM" || UPPER(TEXT(Lead_Originator__c)) = "ADOBE" || UPPER(TEXT(Lead_Originator__c)) = "UNICA" || UPPER(TEXT(Lead_Originator__c)) = "MLCRM") && OR( AND( (RecordType.Name = "Commercial CRM Lead" ), ( IF( Expiry_Date__c >= TODAY(), CASE( WEEKDAY(TODAY()), 1, IF(Expiry_Date__c = TODAY(), 1, 0), 7, IF(Expiry_Date__c = TODAY(), 1, 0), 6, IF(Expiry_Date__c <= TODAY() + 3, 1, 0), IF( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status,"Assigned"), ISPICKVAL(Status,"In progress")) , IF(Expiry_Date__c = TODAY() + 2 , 1 , IF( AND( (Expiry_Date__c = TODAY() + 1), (ISPICKVAL(Lead_Originator__c, "ADOBE")) ) , 1, 0) ) , IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,"Outcome") , ISPICKVAL(Lead_Outcome__c,"Opportunity Identified") ) , IF(Expiry_Date__c = TODAY() + 2 , 1 , IF(Expiry_Date__c = TODAY() + 1 , 1, 0)) , 0) ) ) = 1 , false ) ) ), AND( (RecordType.DeveloperName = "MLCRM_Lead"), IF(OR(Text(Status) == "New",Text(Status) == "In progress",Text(Status) == "Opportunity Identified"), CASE(Lead_Originator__c, "Adobe", IF(Expiry_Date__c = TODAY()+ VALUE($Label.ML_AdobeLeadExpiryRemainder),1,0), "UNICA", IF(Expiry_Date__c = TODAY()+ VALUE($Label.ML_UnicaOrManualLeadExpiryRemainder),1,0),"MLCRM", IF(Expiry_Date__c =TODAY()+VALUE($Label.ML_UnicaOrManualLeadExpiryRemainder), 1, 0),0)=1 ,false) ) )
CustomField.label: Expiry Notification Check
